changelog.summary: Desktop acceptance follow-up after the owner's BUG-002 diagnostics. Confirms that 'Generate handoff package' writes only the handoff directory and that the Publisher ZIP is a separate export written under <workspace>/exports/, never inside the handoff directory. Adds a 'Package existing handoff (.zip)' recovery action for users who already have a complete handoff directory without a ZIP: it packages existing bytes without regenerating payloads or duplicating identities, deterministically. The packaged Electron test reproduces the owner's 29-resource / 19-media / ~8.7 MiB handoff, verifies every payload hash, exports the ZIP, removes it, restarts and re-packages it with an identical SHA-256. Also includes the alpha.11 fixes: persisted-value/project-save error with schema-v3 migration, blank-renderer root cause with an error boundary and redacted diagnostics, media dependency policy, honest progress and selection counts, simpler auth/advanced configuration, persisted 90-150% text size, configurable Qortal nodes with a read-only connectivity test, human-readable skipped content types, and the featured-image CMS work from 0.8.0-alpha.8.

desktop.changelog: Desktop 0.8.0-alpha.12: follows the owner's diagnostics for the blank window. Handoff generation and Publisher ZIP export are separate steps; the ZIP now has a dedicated 'Package existing handoff (.zip)' recovery action that packages an existing handoff directory without regenerating resources or duplicating identities. The packaged-Electron acceptance test reproduces the owner's 29-resource / ~8.7 MiB handoff, verifies every payload hash, exports the ZIP, deletes it, restarts and re-packages it byte-identically. Includes all alpha.11 fixes: legacy-project save error, error boundary and redacted renderer diagnostics, real handoff progress, honest progress bars, batch/selection explanations, auth/advanced guidance, 90-150% text size, configurable Qortal nodes, human-readable unsupported-content reporting, and the attachment dependency policy. Rebuilt with CMS 0.8.0-alpha.8.

publisher.changelog: Unchanged in this release; the Publisher artifact is byte-identical to 0.8.0-alpha.2.

cms.changelog: CMS 0.8.0-alpha.8: optional featured images with existing-QDN selection, device upload, preview, replace, remove and deterministic first-suitable-body-image fallback; explicit WordPress featured images preserved; persistence in the native index, qms-qdn-content@1 media.featured and the edit overlay; reuse by content hash; rendering on home cards, lists, detail and search; fee quote includes a new image resource. Adds visible template version and stale-deployment guidance, refuses an untouched one-character automatic slug from a longer title while preserving legitimate short and manual slugs, and fixes media-map array normalization. Includes all CMS 0.8.0-alpha.7/6/5 fixes. See docs/migration-studio/CMS-EDITING-AND-SLUGS.md.
